_comment: Thresholds ONLY. This safe version never writes model names into Antigravity CLI settings — pick models inside Antigravity itself. Presets differ only in when the Context Guardian warns you.

balanced.description: Everyday work: warn at 75 steps / 85k tokens, red at 120 / 135k.
balanced.label: Balanced (recommended)

max.description: Long complex tasks: warn at 100 / 110k, red at 150 / 160k.
max.label: Max Quality

saver.description: Tight credit budget, repetitive edits: warn earlier at 50 / 60k, red at 85 / 95k.
saver.label: Ultra Saver
